title: Soldier teachers
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What skills from military training could be useful in a classroom, and which might be unsuitable?
Should soldiers without teaching qualifications ever be used to address a teacher shortage?
How different are authority and discipline in the military compared with education?
What matters more in a teacher: subject knowledge, teaching skill, patience, or leadership?
Would you feel comfortable if your child were taught by a former soldier? Why or why not?
